title: Cord Spectator
body_html:
The Cord Spectator takes one of KAVU’s most useful belt bags and gives it a full corduroy treatment.

The 6-wale cotton corduroy brings plenty of texture, while the two-compartment layout keeps everyday essentials organized without adding bulk. A padded mesh back panel helps with airflow and comfort, and the adjustable strap lets you wear it around the waist or slung across the body.

Same easy Spectator function. A lot more corduroy.

Details

  • Belt or sling bag with adjustable strap and side-release buckle
  • Two-compartment design with zip closures
  • Padded mesh back panel for breathability and moisture management
  • Waist strap length: 17"–50"
  • Dimensions: 5" x 9"
  • Capacity: 0.5L / 30.5 cu in

Materials

  • 9oz 100% 6-wale cotton corduroy

title: Grab Bag
body_html:
The Grab Bag keeps things simple: a lightweight sling with enough room for the everyday essentials and an easy shape that stays out of your way.

An adjustable strap and side-release buckle make it quick to throw on, while the zippered main compartment keeps your gear secure. Inside, a plastic D-ring key fob gives keys a dedicated place instead of letting them disappear to the bottom.

Finished with KAVU patterned webbing and made in the USA, the Grab Bag is straightforward, functional, and ready to go.

Details

  • Simple sling pack
  • Adjustable strap with side-release buckle
  • Main compartment with zip closure
  • Patterned webbing detail
  • Internal plastic D-ring key fob
  • Strap Drop: 10.5"
  • Dimensions: 14" x 20" x 3"

Made In

  • USA

title: Teannaway Hoodie
body_html:
The Teannaway Hoodie takes one of KAVU’s most dependable fleece layers and gives it a little more coverage.

It keeps the same lightweight certified recycled polar fleece, snap-front construction, zip hand pockets, and reinforced woven elbow overlays as the original Teannaway, then adds a hood for colder starts, windier afternoons, and the days when a beanie just isn’t enough.

Easy to layer, easy to live in, and familiar in all the right ways.

Details

  • Casual fit
  • Half-placket hooded fleece pullover
  • Logo snap closure
  • Accent fabric along hood opening
  • Single chest pocket with logo snap closure
  • Reinforced accent fabric overlays at elbows
  • Jersey-lined zip hand pockets
  • Elastic binding at sleeve cuffs and bottom opening
  • Length: XS/28", S/28.5", M/29", L/29.5", XL/30", XXL/30.5"
  • Sizes: XS–XXL

Materials

  • 7.5oz 100% certified recycled polyester polar fleece
  • Solid, color-blocked, and printed fleece with sublimation print
  • Accent Fabric: 3oz 100% polyester plain weave woven

Prefer the original? Check out the Teannaway.

title: Eastward
body_html:
The Eastward Scarf takes KAVU’s printed polar fleece and gives it one very simple job: keep your neck warm.

Soft 7.5oz certified recycled polyester fleece makes it lightweight, cozy, and easy to wrap up without a lot of bulk. The all-over prints bring the personality, while the long, straightforward shape makes it an easy cold-weather layer.

Warm neck. Wild print. Job done.

Details

  • Printed polar fleece scarf
  • KAVU logo label
  • Dimensions: 72" x 11"

Materials

  • 7.5oz 100% certified recycled polyester polar fleece
  • Sublimation print

Sustainability

  • Uses certified recycled polyester

title: Benny
body_html:
The Benny is a full-on personality piece built for cold days, loud color, and making a little more out of a simple beanie.

The 9-gauge jacquard knit gives the pattern plenty of presence, while the recycled polyester blend keeps it soft, warm, and easy to wear. No cuff, no pom, no extra fuss — just a clean beanie shape with bold KAVU graphics doing all the work.

Big pattern. Simple shape. Instant favorite.

Details

  • Standard beanie
  • Jacquard knit design
  • KAVU clip label at side
  • One size fits most

Materials

  • 70% certified recycled polyester
  • 30% acrylic yarn
  • 9-gauge knit

title: Retro Block
body_html:
A striped fleece beanie with a little retro flavor and plenty of cold-weather mileage.

The thick 6-gauge acrylic knit gives it a substantial feel, while the ribbed cuff keeps the fit snug and easy to wear. Two colorways keep the look simple, graphic, and just nostalgic enough.

Good stripes. Warm head. Done.

Details

  • Thick ribbed cuffed beanie
  • KAVU clip label at front
  • One size fits most

Materials

  • 100% acrylic yarn
  • 6-gauge knit

title: Yakutat
body_html:
The Yakutat keeps things simple with a clean fleece build and an easy shape that works just about anywhere.

Made from soft REPREVE recycled polar fleece, it’s lightweight, warm, and easy to throw on through the colder months. A small KAVU clip label at the front keeps the finish understated.

Named for Yakutat, Alaska, a fishing community with deep Tlingit roots. The name is often translated as “the place where canoes rest.” Hard to argue with that.

Details

  • Standard fleece beanie
  • KAVU clip label at front
  • One size fits most

Materials

  • 100% certified recycled polyester REPREVE polar fleece

Sustainability

  • Made with certified recycled polyester
  • REPREVE is a recycled performance fiber made using recycled materials, including post-consumer plastic bottles, helping give existing materials another life instead of relying solely on virgin polyester

title: Hazelwood
body_html:
The Hazelwood is a full-length corduroy pant with an easy, relaxed shape and a little extra KAVU detail.

The 12-wale stretch corduroy gives it soft texture with enough flexibility for everyday wear, while the high rise and wide leg keep the silhouette clean and comfortable. A fixed front waist with elastic at the back helps dial in the fit, and side patch pockets with patterned webbing add just enough personality.

Classic corduroy. Better pockets. Easy all season.

Details

  • High-rise, wide-leg full-length pant
  • Fixed waist with elastic at back
  • Button and zip fly
  • Belt loops
  • Front hand pockets

title: Harlowton
body_html:
The Harlowton brings a little ’90s KAVU DNA into a cleaner, more modern pant shape.

Made from 8oz stretch cotton twill, it has enough structure to hold the semi-barrel silhouette while still giving you room to move. The high rise and ankle-length cut keep the shape current, while built-in patterned webbing cinch straps at the sides nod back to KAVU’s heritage without turning the whole thing into a throwback.

A little vintage influence. A lot easier to wear now.

The Quinn is an easygoing shirt jacket with a slightly oversized fit and just enough weight for crisp days.

Made from 7.5oz certified organic cotton double-faced flannel, it has a soft brushed feel with a little more substance than a standard button-up. The boyfriend fit leaves room to layer, while chest pockets, lower hand pockets, and adjustable cuffs give it the utility of a light jacket without overcomplicating things.

Part shirt. Part jacket. Mostly just useful.

title: Moondrift
body_html:
The Moondrift is a classic PNW flannel with a softer hand and an easy, relaxed shape.

Made from 7oz certified organic cotton flannel, the yarn-dyed twill is lightly brushed for extra softness without losing its structure. Two chest pockets, adjustable cuffs, and a clean back yoke keep the construction straightforward, while the rich colorways do most of the talking.

Soft enough for everyday wear. Substantial enough to earn its place in the layering rotation.

The Long Sleeve Girl Party takes a warm-weather favorite and gets it ready for the colder half of the year.

Made from certified organic cotton twill with a soft peached face, it keeps the relaxed button-up shape of the original while adding full sleeves and a little more substance for fall and winter. The all-over digital print brings the party, while the clean pocket setup, adjustable cuffs, and easy curved hem keep it wearable well beyond ski season.

Same party. Longer night.

title: Alyeska

The Alyeska is a soft, substantial turtleneck built for cold days without feeling overly buttoned up.

The 10.5oz four-way stretch waffle knit gives it warmth, texture, and plenty of movement, while the drop-shoulder shape keeps the fit relaxed through the upper body. Flatlock seams help keep things smooth, and the deep curved hem gives you a little extra coverage.

Warm, stretchy, and very easy to settle into.

  • Semi-fitted turtleneck
  • Relaxed drop-shoulder silhouette
  • Ribbed sleeve cuffs

title: Campton
body_html:
The Campton is a soft, easy long sleeve tee with just enough KAVU personality to keep it from feeling basic.

Made from 5.5oz certified organic cotton jersey, it has a relaxed fit that works on its own or under a layer when the weather cools down. Depending on the colorway, the graphic lands on the front or back, giving each version its own feel without changing the easy everyday setup.

Simple shape. Good fabric. KAVU where it counts.

Details

  • Relaxed-fit long sleeve t-shirt
  • Crew neckline
  • Screen print on front or back depending on colorway

title: Wood Valley
body_html:
The Wood Valley is a chunky crew neck sweater with enough texture and personality to carry the whole outfit.

The fully fashioned 7-gauge knit gives it a substantial, cozy feel, while the relaxed fit and hip-length shape keep it easy to wear. Ribbed trim at the collar, cuffs, and hem cleans up the silhouette without taking away from the oversized, throw-it-on appeal.

A little retro, a little outdoorsy, and very easy to get along with.

Details

  • Relaxed-fit chunky crew neck sweater
  • Fully fashioned 7-gauge knit
  • Ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem

title: Echo Valley
body_html:
The Echo Valley takes the familiar feel of a flannel and gives it enough insulation to work as a proper cold-weather layer.

The brushed cotton twill shell keeps the outside classic, while high-pile sherpa through the body and collar adds warmth where you feel it most. Quilted taffeta lining in the sleeves makes layering easier, and patterned KAVU webbing at the hand pockets brings in just enough detail to keep it from feeling too traditional.

Flannel on the outside. Sherpa where it counts.

Details

  • Semi-fitted full-zip sherpa-lined jacket
  • High-pile sherpa collar and body lining
  • Stylized hand pockets with patterned KAVU webbing
  • Adjustable sleeve cuffs
  • Quilted sleeve lining with fill
  • Straight pieced hem
  • Length: XXS/23.5", XS/24", S/24.5", M/25", L/25.5", XL/26", XXL/26.5"

  • Body Lining / Outer Collar: 7.5oz 100% polyester high-pile sherpa fleece

title: Cedar Cove
body_html:
The Cedar Grove gives you two jackets in one, with a soft fleece side for warmth and a smooth woven side when the weather starts to turn.

The recycled polyester polar fleece brings the cozy factor, while the reverse uses a lightweight water-resistant woven fabric for a little more protection from wind and drizzle. Both sides get their own welt hand pockets, and the three-panel hood, elastic binding, and relaxed fit keep the whole thing easy to layer and easy to live in.

Flip it. Reverse it. Pick your side.

Details

  • Relaxed-fit reversible full-zip jacket
  • Three-panel hood
  • Welt hand pockets on both sides
  • Elastic binding at hood, sleeve cuffs, and hem

  • Water resistant

title: Highland Hills
body_html:
The Highland Hills is an easy fleece pullover with a roomier shape and a slightly more refined finish than your standard trail fleece.

Made from soft 7.5oz certified recycled polyester polar fleece, it has an oversized fit that feels relaxed without losing its shape. The half-zip mock neck gives you some control over ventilation, while the clean elastic binding around the collar, cuffs, and hem adds an elegant, considered finish that elevates the whole piece.

Side welt pockets keep the function simple. Soft fleece, clean lines, and just enough polish.

Materials

title: Chilli Lite Stretch
body_html:
The Chilli Lite Pant goes back to 1997, and this update keeps the original shape while giving the fabric a little more room to move.

The relaxed workwear fit, half-elastic waist, built-in belt, and signature half-moon pockets all stay true to the original. This version swaps in 8oz stretch canvas, adding a little flexibility without losing the structure and durability that made the Chilli Lite a KAVU staple in the first place.

Same ’97 silhouette. A little more give.

  • Half-elastic waist with zip fly and logo shank button
  • Built-in 1" burly belt with YKK center-release buckle

  • Gusset for added mobility
  • Thick thread and double-needle reinforced seams

title: Interbay Scrag Pant
body_html:
The Interbay Scrag Pant is the lighter, looser cousin of the Chilliwack — made for moving around without a lot of fuss.

The 8oz fine stretch twill keeps things durable but flexible, while the loose fit, gusset, and full-length cut give you plenty of room to move. An elastic waist with a built-in patterned webbing belt makes the fit easy to adjust, and reinforced pockets and double-needle seams handle the everyday abuse.

Knock-around pants in the best sense of the word.

  • Reinforced front hand pockets
  • Back patch pockets
  • Gusset for added mobility

title: Pacific Pant
body_html:
The Pacific Pant takes a little inspiration from the vintage workwear we found digging through shops in Shimokitazawa, then rebuilds it for everyday KAVU use.

The loose, ankle-length fit keeps the shape relaxed, while heavyweight stretch canvas gives it enough structure to hold up to regular wear. A half-elastic waistband adds comfort without losing the cleaner front, and reinforced pockets, thick thread, and double-needle seams bring in the tougher workwear details.

Vintage influence. Built for right now.

  • Loose-fit, ankle-length pant
  • Half-elastic waist with zip fly and logo shank button
  • Self-fabric shank button cover
  • Reinforced front hand pockets
  • Reinforced back patch pocket with decorative chain stitch
  • Self-fabric utility loop
  • Thick thread and double-needle reinforced seams

title: Round A Bout
body_html:
The Round A Bout brings a looser, more relaxed shape to the KAVU pant lineup.

Stretch cotton canvas gives it enough structure to feel substantial without getting stiff, while the wide leg and elastic waist keep things easy. A custom drawcord lets you dial in the fit, pork chop hand pockets add a little workwear influence, and reinforced seams are there for the days when sitting still isn’t really the plan.

Loose fit. Tough fabric. Very little ceremony.

  • Reinforced back patch pockets

The Take A Hike Hoodie brings KAVU’s color-blocking habit to a heavyweight fleece layer.

Made from 9.5oz certified organic cotton fleece, it has the same substantial feel as our classic hoodies with a little more visual punch. The color-blocked construction does most of the talking, while a small chest print keeps the graphics clean.

Good color. Good fleece. Take a hike.

The Fade Away Hoodie gives the classic KAVU logo a little more color without messing with a good thing.

The fade treatment adds some depth to the familiar graphic, while the heavyweight 9.5oz certified organic cotton fleece brings plenty of substance for colder days. Finished with a standard unisex fit, drawstring hood, and ribbed cuffs and waistband.

Classic logo. Better fade.

A growling bear takes over the back, with a smaller hit up front to keep things balanced. Underneath the artwork is a beefy 9.5oz certified organic cotton fleece with a standard unisex fit — substantial, comfortable, and ready for colder days.

Two colors. One territorial bear. Seems like enough.

The Salmon Hoodie goes back to where KAVU started.

Part KAVU history. Part really good hoodie.

Live it up. Let the good times roll.

The LS True Fade takes a heritage KAVU logo and gives it a little extra color.

The faded graphic treatment brings a softer, worn-in feel to the classic artwork, with three colorways that each take the fade in a different direction. The 5.5oz certified organic cotton jersey has enough weight for cooler days while staying comfortable for everyday wear.

Old logo. New fade. Still KAVU.

title: Camper
body_html:
This heavyweight long sleeve tee comes with a little KAVU history built into the graphic.

The featured KAVUism was first exclaimed by a new camper in the middle of an especially good trip — the kind of offhand line that sticks around long enough to end up on a shirt. Made from 6.5oz cotton jersey and garment dyed for a broken-in look, it has enough weight to handle cooler days without getting complicated.

Good trips have a way of producing good material.

title: Snow Day
body_html:
This tee is a nod to the kind of winter gear that made snow days fun long before things got overly technical.

Made from soft 5.5oz certified organic cotton jersey, it features a collection of old-school snow toys — skis, basket poles, heritage snowshoes, and sleds — pulled straight from grandpa’s side of the gear closet. A small chest hit keeps the front simple, while the larger back graphic tells the whole story.

Old snow gear. Still a good time.

title: Pacific Pocket T
body_html:
The Pacific Pocket T takes a classic pocket tee and gives it a little KAVU treatment.

Made from 5.5oz certified organic cotton jersey, it has an easy everyday weight and a soft feel against the skin. The single chest pocket keeps things straightforward, while the printed KAVU webbing graphic adds just enough detail to make it ours.

Simple tee. Good pocket. Extra style points.

title: Speckled Trout

title: Chilliwack Short
body_html:
Constructed in the USA from worldwide materials.

Following the lineage of outdoor ready hats, Barry next tackled apparel with the Chilliwack short and pant. Big half-moon back bucket pockets are both function and fashion. They allow for easy pocket entry and loads of carrying capacity but are instantly recognizable. The tough-wearing canvas, built-in belt, half elastic waist, wide leg, and gusset crotch made this style an instant hit with the climbing community. The Chilliwack short is a production marvel and it’s still made the old fashion way. One Chilliwack short requires eight different sewers and nearly 10 hours of sewing. The indestructible seam work is created with nearly thirty individual parts, T40 five thread overlock with double needle top stitching, and thirteen T70 bar tacks - in some places securing 14-ply fabric. These sewing requirements would break industry standard needles. The Chilliwack is sewn utilizing specialized gold needles specifically built to withstand rigorous demands. 

A Heritage item that is Loose fit, half-elastic waist short with logo shank button and zip fly, built-in burly belt with YKK center release buckle, half-moon silhouette pockets with right rear wallet stay, gusset, thick thread and double needle reinforced seams.

body_html:
Did someone call for an adventure vest?? This quick dry poly-cotton stretch vest boasts eight pockets - and if you’re on a KAVU adventure, you’ll use them all. Organization is great but, this much fire needs to breathe - hence the fully mesh-lined back serves as a ventilation window to keep you cool. Design constructed this vest for fishing, camping, hiking, or pulling an all nighter. Like all things KAVU - Engineered For Good Times®.

Born from a National Geographic photo, a used pizza box, and a utility knife, the Chillba is one of those ideas that could only have come out of KAVU HQ. A few sacrificed pizza boxes later, he had a pattern. Working with Mr. Hong, the idea evolved into the Chillba we know today.

Underneath the unmistakable circular brim is some seriously functional headwear. A quick-dry mesh headpiece keeps air moving, while patterned tubular webbing and an adjustable toggle provide a secure fit. KAVU History

The Chillba came to life after customers began asking for a traditional sun hat to follow the original Strapcap. Its unlikely path from a magazine photograph to pizza-box prototype to KAVU classic is a pretty good example of KAVUism #247: “Local Feel, Worldwide Appeal.”

title: Organic Strapcap
body_html:
The Strapcap is where KAVU started.

In 1991, Barry Barr was captaining a commercial salmon fishing boat off the wet, windy coast of Alaska when a gust ripped his hat off and sent it overboard. He figured there had to be a better way to keep a cap on your head in rough weather, so he came up with one.

That idea became the Strapcap: a low-profile four-panel hat anchored by burly patterned nylon webbing, a D-ring adjustment, reinforced bar tacks, and a tough polyurethane bill. It was built for working outside, where wind, water, and weather tend to expose bad design pretty quickly.

More than three decades later, the Strapcap is still hand cut and hand sewn in Seattle by the same family. The construction has stayed remarkably close to the original because, as it turns out, Barry got a lot right the first time.

Now made from 100% certified organic cotton, it is still the hat that started the whole thing.
